path_file.comment: Reading arguments from config file (comments are useless for the code)

output_path.comment: Output folder to store all plots

functionality.help: Select wanted functionality from this list : sst, p_hydro, still_p_hydro, section_hydro, clim_hydro, surface_stream, stream_ADCP, stream_VM_ADCP, drift_buoys

obs_method_z.help: Select colocation method on z axis

mod_names.help: names of models in the same order as their paths

mod_methods.help: Select colocation method for models in the same order as their paths

mod_methods_z.help: Select colocation method_z for models in the same order as their paths

polygon.help: polygon meta-zone defined by a set of coordinates. For example : lon1=-2.72, lat1=47.20,  lat2=50.84, lon2=-4.74  etc simply type : --polygon 47.20,-2.72 50.84,-4.74 etc

cloud.help: cloud meta-zone defined by a set of coordinates. For example : lon1=-2.72, lat1=47.20,  lat2=50.84, lon2=-4.74  etc simply type : --cloud 47.20,-2.72 50.84,-4.74 etc

radius.help: radius around the points to expand the considered area of the cloud

quality.help: minimum and maximum quality of data to take into account

depth.help: One, two or three arguments are allowed : One argument (depth); two arguments (start_depth, end_depth); three arguments (start_depth, end_depth, step)

density.help: One, two or three arguments are allowed : One argument (density); two arguments (start_density, end_density); three arguments (start_density, end_density, step)

bathy.help: minimum and maximum bathymetric to take into account

start.help: values kept from 'start' can be absolute or relative to today

end.help: values kept until 'end' can be absolute or relative to today

frequency.help: values kept at a given frequency stating at the first value of observation dataset

time_highlight.comment: # 4.4.3 - Highlight a list of times on charts

time_restriction.comment: # 4.4.4 - Select restricted time in a day
time_restriction.help: restrict data to certain hours in the day

interval.help: group by interval to compute statistics

cyclic.comment: # 4.4.5 - Select restricted time in a day???????
cyclic.help: restrict data to certain period of the year

vars.help: restrict attributes of on the dataset

vmin.comment: # 5.2 - Select the minimum value on the colormap for the plot
vmin.help: select the minimum value on the colormap for the plot

vmax.comment: # 5.2.1 - Select the maximum value on the colormap for the plot
vmax.help: select the maximum value on the colormap for the plot

colormap.help: select colormap for the the plot

tidal_waves.comment: # 5.4 - Select the tidal waves to calculate in the harmonic analysis

path_results_tide.comment: Folder where to save the files for the harmonic analysis
path_results_tide.help: path where to save the files for the harmonic analysis

path_results_traj.comment: Folder where to save the files for the trajectory calculation
path_results_traj.help: path where to save the files for the trajectory calculation

traj_duration_plot.comment: Duration in s of the trajectories to plot
traj_duration_plot.help: duration in s of the trajectories to plot

traj_freq_plot.comment: Frequency in s of simulated trajectories to plot
traj_freq_plot.help: Frequency in s of simulated trajectories to plot
